signals.title: Suzuki reveals huge sales increase compared with 2025
signals.summary: Suzuki’s expanded motorcycle range and pricing realignments are having a positive impact on sales compared to 2025. Suzuki GB has confirmed a huge increase in motorcycle sales compared to 2025, with more than 1,000 extra units sold year-on-year. This has contributed to a 62 per cent increase in total sales this calendar year, meaning more motorcycles have already been sold in 2026 compared with the entirety of 2025. One of the reasons behind the increase in sales has been the Japanese manufacturer’s willingness to reduce the overall prices of its models. In the last year alone, Suzuki has revealed price realignments across 13 of its road-going models, including the GSX-S1000GX+, which has seen its OTR (on the road) price reduced by nearly £3,000. Additionally, the company has also dropped £1,000 from the original prices of its modern classic GSX-8T and GSX-8TT bikes, both of which are part of Suzuki’s recently expanded range. You might be interested in reading our 2025 Suzuki GSX-8T and GSX-8TT review . Speaking of the brand’s growing line-up, we must make mention of the returning GSX-R1000R, and the newly-launched SV-7GX, which was unveiled at the 2025 EICMA show in Milan, Italy, last November. The GSX-R1000R is one of the company’s most iconic models, while the SV-7GX offers a very affordable way into the middleweight sports touring segment at £6,999. signals.title: New Ducati Panigale V4 SP model expected for 2027
signals.summary: A new Ducati Panigale V4 SP looks set to position itself between the standard V4 and the race homologated V4 R in 2027. Ducati looks set to usher in a new Panigale V4 SP for 2027, which has been certified via documents from the California Air Resources Board (CARB), according to a report from Motorcycle.com . The SP name is no stranger to Ducati, and has been used by the Italian marque across numerous model line-ups in the past. However, there is currently no SP variant in the heavily saturated Panigale V4 range. But that looks set to change heading into 2027, with the new Panigale V4 SP likely to position itself somewhere between the standard V4, and the race homologated V4 R, which is used by teams in major championships such as the WorldSBK series, and BSB . CARB had already certified the 2027 Ducati Panigale V4 line-up in March 2026, although Ducati is believed to have submitted a revised version last month, specifically mentioning the new V4 SP. The inclusion of a new SP version should come as no surprise after the previous generation V4 featured SP and SP2 models. Details of the new V4 SP remain scarce, however, we do know that it will feature the same 1,103cc engine that’s used by other Panigale V4 bikes. Expect the new V4 SP to feature a spec sheet not too dissimilar from the V4 R, and one that is therefore higher than the current V4. signals.summary: Legendary stunt rider Rick English has revealed his favourite Kawasaki motorcycle to use when performing movie scenes. Veteran stunt performer Rick English has revealed his “go-to” motorcycle to use for stunt scenes, as well as his favourite type of movie stunt to perform, which may surprise you. English is one of the UK’s biggest names when it comes to the stunt world, which has seen him perform major stunts in numerous blockbuster films. English, who has over 27 years of experience in the industry, has delivered stunts in James Bond, Mission: Impossible and Jason Bourne movies. He has also ridden Batman’s iconic Batcycle, while he recently worked alongside Jason Momoa on the 2026 film, Supergirl. Below is a social media post from when English was spotted filming a scene in The Flash movie a few years ago. This has led English to ride, but also drive, some of the most iconic motorcycles and cars seen in Hollywood movies over the years, but when speaking to Kawasaki UK, English went on to discuss which type of stunt scene is his favourite, revealing a particularly surprising answer. "I do a lot of car stunt driving as well, and getting behind the wheel of the Batmobile has definitely been one of the highlights. signals.title: Kawasaki offers £1,500 part-exchange boost on hybrid bikes
signals.summary: Kawasaki is offering £1,500 towards a part-exchange on its Z 7 Hybrid and Ninja 7 Hybrid, with the deal running until the end of September. Kawasaki is offering riders a £1,500 part-exchange allowance on its Z 7 Hybrid and Ninja 7 Hybrid, in an attempt to make its unusual hybrid motorcycles a little easier to get into. The offer applies to both models and runs until 30 September 2026. Kawasaki is also promoting the bikes alongside its K-Options finance package, although the exact monthly payment will depend on the deal and individual circumstances. The Z 7 Hybrid and Ninja 7 Hybrid arrived in 2024 and are notable for being the first mass-produced strong hybrid motorcycles. Both use Kawasaki's 451cc parallel-twin engine alongside an electric motor and a relatively small battery pack, with the system designed to provide a mixture of petrol and electric propulsion rather than simply using electrification as a fuel-saving exercise. Kawasaki claims the hybrid setup can deliver acceleration comparable with a 1,000cc-class supersport bike while returning fuel economy more in line with a 250cc machine. That's a bold claim, although the hybrid system's real party trick is its ability to switch between different riding modes depending on what you're asking of it. The bikes can operate using the petrol engine, electric motor or both together, with the rider able to select from several modes. signals.title: Benelli TRK 902 Xplorer, beyond the map
signals.summary: Benelli expands its lineup with the TRK 902 Xplorer , a crossover built for riders eager to push their wheels far beyond the asphalt. The new adventure machine's off-road DNA is clear at a glance: a compact, manually adjustable windscreen, handguards with integrated turn signals, standard LED auxiliary lights, and—most importantly—spoked wheels measuring 19 inches up front and 17 in the rear, wrapped in Pirelli Scorpion Rally STR M+S tires. Feeding the journey is a 21-liter fuel tank, while a punchy 904cc twin-cylinder engine beats at its core, pumping out 93.2 hp (68.5 kW) at 9,000 rpm and 90 Nm of torque at 6,500 rpm. Power delivery is managed by a Ride-By-Wire throttle featuring three distinct riding modes: Normal, Rain, and Sport . The sturdy steel trellis frame with reinforcing plates is paired with a fully adjustable 43mm Marzocchi upside-down fork (handling rebound, compression, and preload). In the rear, a monoshock with a remote adjuster handles hydraulic rebound damping and spring preload. Suspension travel sits at a generous 170mm, ground clearance reaches 215mm, and the seat height is set at an accessible 840mm. Stopping power is anchored by Brembo: dual 320mm discs with 4-piston radial calipers up front, and a single 260mm disc with a 2-piston caliper in the back, all governed by a disengageable cornering ABS for supreme off-road control. signals.summary: LSUV Terlaris Juli 2026: Xpander Cross Melonjak, Rush Masih Dominan JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com Toyota Rush masih menjadi low sport utility vehicle (LSUV) terlaris di Indonesia pada Juli 2026. Berdasarkan data Gabungan Industri Kendaraan Bermotor Indonesia ( Gaikindo ), distribusi Rush dari pabrik ke diler alias wholesales mencapai 2.548 unit. Angka tersebut naik 7,3 persen dibanding satu bulan lalu yang mencatat 2.374 unit. Daihatsu Terios mengikuti di posisi kedua dengan distribusi 1.458 unit, tumbuh 3,6 persen dari 1.407 unit pada Juni 2026. signals.title: Populasi Kendaraan Listrik Indonesia Sudah Tembus Ratusan Ribu Unit
signals.summary: Populasi Kendaraan Listrik Indonesia Sudah Tembus Ratusan Ribu Unit JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com Sepeda motor listrik menjadi kelompok terbesar dalam populasi kendaraan listrik berbasis baterai (KBLBB) di Indonesia. Hingga sekitar April 2026, jumlah motor listrik mencapai lebih dari separuh total kendaraan listrik yang beredar di Tanah Air. Berdasarkan data yang diolah Kementerian Perindustrian (Kemenperin), total populasi kendaraan listrik di Indonesia telah mencapai 468.231 unit hingga April 2026. Dari jumlah tersebut, kendaraan listrik roda dua mencapai 242.909 unit, sedangkan kendaraan listrik roda empat penumpang sebanyak 223.100 unit. Baca juga: Membaca Fenomena Jaecoo J5 EV di Tengah Gempuran SUV Listrik Indonesia United Mahasiswa UNISSULA kunjungi pabrik motor listrik United Artinya, populasi motor listrik saat ini masih lebih besar dibandingkan mobil listrik. Jika dibandingkan dengan total populasi KBLBB yang tercatat, motor listrik menyumbang sekitar 51,9 persen, sementara mobil listrik penumpang sekitar 47,6 persen. Besarnya populasi tersebut menunjukkan bahwa elektrifikasi kendaraan roda dua menjadi salah satu bagian penting dalam perkembangan ekosistem kendaraan listrik nasional. Perkembangan kendaraan listrik nasional mencatat pertumbuhan yang sangat cepat. Populasi KBLBB disebut mengalami pertumbuhan eksponensial dengan compound annual growth rate (CAGR) lebih dari 150 persen sepanjang 2020-2025.
